plugins.name: prompt-recap
plugins.description: Your prompts, what you added mid-turn and how each turn ended, plus the session's goal, what's happening now, what's waiting on you and the next step, in a pane beside the chat. Press a prompt to jump back to it.

plugins.name: boot-console
plugins.description: Build and run a Spring Boot app the way IntelliJ's Run does (compile what changed, start its main class from the compiled classes), with its log live in a pane beside the chat. Run, Stop, Restart, Build; profile, JVM options and JDK per project.

plugins.name: file-tree
plugins.description: Your project's folders and files as a tree in a pane beside the chat, as IntelliJ's Project view draws them, in git's colours. Press a folder to open it, a file to edit it right there: Enter for a new line, Ctrl+S to save.
